Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report shows mixed news, with unemployment edging down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic city views and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora, I visited your website. It's clear and straightforward, and the contact info is easy to find. It could be improved with more content, such as an intro about who you are, your projects or work, and some visual design to make it more engaging.

Hi Eve, I enjoyed visiting your blog. Sharing your love of hiking gives it a personal touch. It could be even better with more posts, photos of your hikes, trail recommendations, and some navigation to help readers find content.
